verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own marketing documents pipeline and opportunity management with pipeline visibility, which covers the core idea of tracking deals through a pipeline. Nothing in the pack shows a visual board, customizable stages, or drag-and-drop stage updates. missing for 10: evidence of a visual (kanban-style) pipeline view, customizable deal stages, drag-and-drop updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Get complete visibility into your pipeline. Surface insights to speed up prospecting and opportunity management.
